balls.text: finishes it off with a full delivery, the off stump goes towards the keeper. Chawla makes room, and misses, and the poor off stump...
this time the deer charges at the headlights! Similar delivery, and pulls this one over midwicket
short, quick, no room, and Chawla is like a deer in the headlights, and defends it to the bowler
yorker, just a single to short fine leg
left alone! Sunny backs away, Tait bowls a bouncer outside off. No shot! And for the record, Asnani has called one for the over

and he gets another wicket, not with the best ball he has bowled, though. This was short, and gentle in pace when compared to Tait's usual pace, but McLaren pulls it straight down deep midwicket's lap
comes back with a superb yorker, right on the crease, dot ball
okay, one bouncer too many, Sunny is waiting, and pulls it to midwicket
short again, pulled away for just a single
mean short delivery, heads towards his neck, and Sunny drops it at his feet and runs
full and wide, would have been a wide, but he gets the toe end of his bat there and gets a single
and that frustration shows as Marsh gets a top edge on this pull off the front foot. Watson calls for it, and takes it without trouble. Rajasthan are back momentarily

angled across, and that beats the attempted scoop. Superb comeback from Trivedi, which means he is only tied with RP Singh for the worst figures in all IPLs, and doesn't exclusively own the dubious distinction

another bouncer, and Asnani calls it one for the over, although I can bet my house the previous bouncer was over shoulder too, and this should have been a no-ball. Good on Sid Trivedi, though, to realise that one for the over had not been called and then going for another bouncer
another slower bouncer, and McLaren misses again, these are three superb overs
slower bouncer, and McLaren ducks under it
slower ball, driven down to long-off for one
clipped away off the pads, and he hares back for two to keep the strike
and nightmare it is, as he bowls a big wide down the leg side, too wide for Yagnik to collect it cleanly
just holds its line outside off, and Marsh ends up pushing inside its line

Nayar is gone. He looked to drop and run, and then stopped. Then he saw Marsh charging at him and realised it would be criminal to turn his back at Marsh, and went for the single anyway. That stutter, though, cost him his wicket
punched away to extra cover for another single
a good bouncer, gets the top edge, but - why am I not surprised - it lands safe in front of fine leg
pushed to point, they keep him on strike
cut away to third man for one

Tait finally gets a deserved wicket... it's shortish but not wide, and it's fast and bounces more than expected. The edge is taken by the keeper, and then the umpire's finger comes up ever so slowly as Karthik starts to walk and then stops
slower ball, another fumble from Yagnik, and the bye doesn't amuse Tait
walks across the line to try and pull, is beaten by the pace, gets a leg-bye
pulled away to deep midwicket, gets a single
cut to third man for another single
opens the face, gets a single to point
beaten for pace, and it's called a wide as it angles away. That's harsh, the batsman had reached the line of the ball, and didn't have to overstretch
this is getting ridiculous now! Karthik is down on a knee expecting another slower ball, and scoops it over short fine
regulation pace, regulation result, as he cuts this short and wide delivery square of point and fine of third man
there is no surprise in this slower ball. Karthik is standing deep in the crease, waiting, "Come, come". It finally arrives and is pulled for four
and he almost took Karthik out here. Hit straight back to Karthik's gut, who does well to get out of the way. And is thus still standing on his own two feet
short ball, stays low, but he still recovers enough to place it square of short fine leg
steered to third man for a single

that's not how you treat a legend, not one who might have played with your father back in the day... Third six in the over, via another slog sweep. Warne is quiet now. Liz Hurley is watching from the stands
shorter, gets a couple to deep midwicket
50 off 29 deliveries! And another slog-sweep. Much straighter this time, but it defies gravity just as long-on thinks he might have a chance
that's the first uncultured shot Marsh has played all night. And it's might effective too. Slog-swept way into the stands
on the pads, helped away for a single
shapes up for the slog sweep, but then sees it dip viciously and ends up cutting it straight to point
flicked away off the stumps for one
slog-sweep, along the ground, gets a single to deep midwicket
extra bounce, and it goes straight on, hitting him in the pad
cut away for one
and another lovely extra-cover drive for four. He is just bettering the previous shots with every new one through the covers
under edge on the cut, and it bounces straight into the keeper's mouth. The helmets be blessed
full again, and Menaria dives to his right to save the single
first full delivery, and it is blocked by Karthik
cut away for one this time
another long hop, and he can't get away with three hit-me deliveries. Marsh pulls this deservedly for four
that's a very round-arm for an SLA. Short and wide, cut away for one
starts off with a long hop, but Marsh doesn't get all of it, and gets just a single to deep midwicket
placed wide of cover this time
Marsh plays the extra-cover drive even better, beautiful shot. Lazy it looks, and that's why it looks so good. Driven wide of long-off and straight of extra cover
Karthik drives nicely past extra cover, all along the ground. It is so well timed that Watson at sweeper cover has to put in a dive to keep them down to three
driven wide of cover for a single this time
driven uppishly, short of cover
full on the pads, clipped away
wide down the leg side
back of a length, hit back to Warne, who lets the throw rip back
Marsh is looking solid, placing this wide of long-on for two. Called one short, though

the have broken the code! They have dismissed Valthaty! No. 50 in IPL for Warner. And what revs on this one. Valthaty comes down the track looking for another six, but the dip leaves him ever so short of the pitch of the ball, and he hits this off the lower part of the bat. Tait collects the mis-hit at long-off
respects the respectable legbreak, defending it to cover
Long hop! And that can mean only one thing. Another six for Valthaty. Not his fault that Warne bowled a juicy half-tracker on the pads
chipped towards deep midwicket again, gets a single
slower full toss, quite non-happeningly turned away for a single
The casino is waiting Paul! Another mis-hit towards long-off, and Asnodkar comes charging in, puts the dive in, but it bursts through his hands. And he hurts himself too as he takes the fall
As soon as the match finishes, Valthaty must go to a casino! Slower ball, he skies it and it falls between mid-off and long-off. Two fielders go after you, after you
pushed to long-off for one
slower ball, the inside edge gets him a single towards square leg
back of a length, pushed wide of cover for a single
punched away, but finds extra cover
opens the face on this, uses soft hands, and they take a single
defends this one back to the bowler
lovely batting, for all the hitting here, marsh has played three beautiful shots quietly. This time he comes down the track and chips Warne over midwicket. No violence
short again, cut away to sweeper-cover
sharp legbreak, played towards point
and Marsh matches it with the extra-cover drive! Comes forward, opens the bat face slightly to place this wide of extra cover. Amazing batting
another incredible shot. Back of a length, and he punches it on the up, back at Watson, who gets a hand to it, saving three runs
runs this off the face of the bat to third man
clipped away off the pads for a single to square leg
pitched up around off, driven to cover
full outside off, pushed to cover for one
maiden over! And the score in 77 after six over! Paul tries the upper-cut again, and is beaten by the pace again
Valthaty backs away and swings, but misses this shortish delivery outside off
an indication of Tait's pace is that this one hits Valthaty in the hip area, and flies across the outfield for four leg byes
bouncer, chest-high, Valthaty backs away to attempt the upper-cut. No connection, though
short and wide, Valthaty goes for a wild cut, misses
starts with a nice yorker, which Valthaty drives to mid-off
shorter this time, left alone outside off
beautiful shot! Overpitched delivery, and he off-drives it between bowler and mid-off. High elbow and all that
drives away from the body again, gets a thick edge square of third man to take a couple
angled across Marsh, nearly gets the edge as marsh drives away from the body
finally something goes Rajasthan's way! Gilchrist goes for another powerful hit, doesn't get the elevation and Tait takes the easy catch at mid-on. What relief for rajasthan
wide and shortish, punched away, but finds extra cover
under edge on the sweep here, and he still gets a couple as this goes fine of short fine leg
decent delivery again, but cut away from back of a length, and takes a couple to wide to sweeper-cover
mis-fielded this time! gently tapped back to Warne's left, he doesn't collect cleanly, and they steal the single
carnage continues... short again, on the pads, flicked between square leg and midwicket
and RR continue to bleed! A filthy long hop from Warner, Gilly says thank you very much mate, pulling it into the stands
back of a length, stays back and defends
and he slogs at this one, what a shame. The mis-hit goes only as far as square leg
another no-ball! And it's a low full toss on the pads too, and he has flicked it wide of square leg to bring up the fastest team fifty in IPL history
no more peace... slower ball, picks it up early, makes room, and sends it crashing over point
slower ball now, respectfully defended. Peace brother
Valthatyyyyyy! Unstoppable. Nothing wrong with the delivery, back of a length, on middle, and he short-arm-pulls it over midwicket for another six. What wrists on this
Ooof, what a beautiful shot! Length ball, lofted over mid-on. High elbow. Holds the pose
this was a bouncer in slow motion compared to the pace Tait is bowling at, and Valthaty pulls it without any trouble for six

and now Tait's pace is hurting Tait himself. Gilchrist rocks back to a short-of-a-length delivery and punches it wide of mid-off. And my word, does it travel. Looked like a single when it left his bat. Turns out to be a four, beating the mid-off to the fence. The outfield is as quick as Tait
wide down the leg side, and Yagnik is ordinary with the keeping gloves, and Tait speaks a famous four-letter word out loud
slower ball outside off, left alone
and Valthaty pours salt on that wound! Makes room and lofts this free-hit deliver over extra cover

short ball, gets big, and gone! Hang on, though, they are checking it for no-ball, and that too on both counts - front foot and back foot cutting the side line! And he has cut the side line. Two wickets, two no-balls! What a shame. And it was superbly worked out too. Short ball, rising up, two gullies, and guided to the second one of that
full at 149.5ks, Gilly takes a single to mid-on
and he has hit the leather off this short ball outside off, but there is a deep point in place to keep them down to one
bouncer at 150.3ks, nice start, and Gilchrist is late on the pull, which falls short of fine leg
pushed wide of mid-off to retain the strike
wide outside off, angling away, second extra of the over
gets the inside half of the bat on a drive, and gets two runs wide of square leg
and the free hit has got the deserving treatment, the gentle half-tracker has been pulled over midwicket

it's all happening! Bowled off a no-ball! And Gilchrist doesn't know of the no-ball, and is walking back when one RR fielder disturbs the bails and appeals for a run-out. Good try. Good knowledge of cricket rules. Well done Dinesh Yagnik
nice punch shot, he seemed to have just defended this length ball, and then it screamed across between cover and extra cover
and a repeat, left alone again, and bounces in front of the keeper again. And to say that the wicket is all green
angled across, left alone, bounces in front of the wicketkeeper
slogged away to long-on for another single, and Zinta hugs whoever is around her. The biggest win in this season
square-drive this time, just the single
lovely shot Warner! Comes down the track and lofts his straight over his head
digs out a yorker-length delivery
comes down the track, yorks himself, gets a single to long-on
wicket No. 2 for Bhatt, as Raut toe-ends this high towards point for a simple catch. it was just a wild slog
gets this yorker right, concedes just the single
full and wide of off, guides it past point for four
full outside off, digs it out for another single
slower one, wide down the leg side
connects with this full toss, hits it wide of sweeper-cover
full toss outside off, ends up playing inside its line
yorker outside leg, digs it out for one
slog-swept for a single
full delivery played to midwicket
short, very slow, and he has finished his shot before the ball arrives
wristily played, but straight to midwicket
gentle half-volley wide of off, and driven past extra cover for four. Top shot
hit straight down long-on's throat, and Bhatt celebrates as if he has taken Tendulkar's wicket with one run needed off the last ball. In his mind he must be bowling the Super Over
full ball outside off, gets a single to midwicket
half-volley, hit straight to long-off for one
yorker, digs it out, gets a single to square leg
backs away, bowlers follows him, concedes just the single to midwicket
full outside off, driven for one
takes a single to long-on
swept away in the air, but falls short of deep midwicket
googly, cut away straight to extra cover
runs this down to point and speeds across for a single
clipped off the pads for another single
ridiculous umpiring, allows a leg-bye there as Raut jumps out of the crease and thrusts his pad at this, the bat hidden well behind the pad
legbreak to begin with, defended to point
what a drop! Raut charges at McLaren, and sends the slower ball to the moon and back, but Chawla never ever looks like he has got under it, and it bursts through his hands and hits him in the chest
backs away again, and this time McLaren bowls outside off, beating Raut again
cramps up Raut who is moving about in the crease, with a length delivery aimed for the leg stump
poor delivery down the leg side, and he guides it fine of fine leg
slashed away fine of a very square third man for four
backs away, McLaren follows him with a bouncer, and beats his attempt at an upper-cut
slower delivery again, played towards point for one
back of a length, quicker delivery, stays back and defends
another slower bat, hit to long-on for one
slower ball, flicked away to square leg where Sunny Singh dives and saves the run
cut away to sweeper-cover for one
back of a length, outside off, punched to cover
Gone! Length ball, he had to go for it, got under it, but not enough, and doesn't get enough height, thus hitting it straight down long-on's throat
gentle half-volley on off, Binny clears the front leg and crashes it between mid-off and extra cover
angling into the pads, helped away for one
short, wide, cut away above point, gets four

dropped! The wrong man went for it. Binny just swings blindly at a short ball, and the edge flies between point and third man, and marsh, who is running backwards, goes for it, and doesn't even get a touch on it as it falls over his shoulder
clipped away off the pads for a single
legbreak around off, opens the face and takes a single
swept away upon making room, gets a single to deep square
superb shot, comes down the track again, and muscles this over Chawla's head
full toss, and hit straight to midwicket, missed out
this is better, he goes with the spin, over long-off. Comes down the track, close enough to the pitch of the ball, and throws all he has at this, and the ball keeps travelling over long-off
slog-swept, gets the toe end again, straight to midwicket
just clears PK at long-on. Hit powerfully, seemed it was going straight to the fielder, but it kept going, just over PK's raised hand
another slower ball, Menaria ends up hitting it back to the bowler
slower ball, stays low, gets the toe end on it, gets a single to deep midwicket
driven down the ground and along it, gets a single
bisects long-on and long-off, but surely this is too little, too late
heaves away at this slower one, gets a single to midwicket
sliced away past point
hit in the air and straight towards long-off, bounces in front, though
wrong'un, gets a thick outside edge for a single
another shot straight to fielder, extra cover this time
full, played straight to midwicket
cut away just wide of deep point, wide enough for them to come back for two
driven to long-on for one
cut away, square of third man, comes back for two
the split-finger slower one, pushed to long-on for one
pushed wide of long-off, comes through for one
stump to stump, pushed back to the bowler
back of a length, chipped to long-on for one

Chawla has worked Taylor. Googly from wide of the crease, Taylor caught on the crease, hit in front of leg, and is given. Looked harsh live time because I thought it was missing leg, but Taylor was so deep in the crease it made it easier for Reiffel. Replays show it would have kissed the outside of the leg stump
looks to paddle this one, gets some glove on its way to the pad, else he was a dead duck
legbreak this time, slower through the air, pitches middle and off, breaks away, beating the prod by Taylor
googly, wide of the stumps too, hits Taylor on the pad
backs away to go over extra, but it skids on again, hurrying him up. Gets  a single to cover
skiddish legbreak, hurries him up, defended
length ball, defended back to the bowler
short ball again, pulled away to deep square for one
low full toss, hit to extra cover. Another dot
Is that the game? Shrewd slower short ball. Watson sets himself up for a six over midwicket, but the fall never arrives, and when it does it takes the top edge. Caught around mid-on area
short ball, cramps Binny up, concedes just the single
into the pads, worked away for a single
full toss, driven down to long-off for one
backs away, muscles this down the ground, a diving save keeps them down to two
dropped! Was blind-sighted to be fair perhaps. Makes room to hit, gets a fine fine edge, and it hits Gilly's pad
comes down the track to chip this over mid-on for two
looks to make room and go over extra, the thick outside edge goes towards point
full on pads, gets a single to long-on
another slower ball, worked away to midwicket for another single
slower ball, opens the face to bring Watson back on strike
back of a length, holding its line, pushed to mid-off
flicked away to square leg, no run
angling into the pads, misses out, but gets a leg-bye
slightly slower, Watson drives at it, gets a thick inside edge that eludes both the stumps and the keeper. PK's neckchain, which seems to have emptied a whole mine in Gauteng, dangles
steers this to third man for a single
short, Watto sees it early, and pulls this over midwicket. Ominously Watto has started off
hit straight back towards the stumps this time, Harris fields in the follow through
superb drive, back of a length, hit on the up, between cover and extra cover
better line, around off, defended towards cover
length ball on the pads, gently clipped away, and gently it beats short fine leg, for four gentle runs
bowled him! Another very low full toss, beats Asnodkar who is looking to make room again, and hits the leg stump 10 inches up
makes room, PK follows him, and he goes leg side, getting four wide of midwicket
full, very low full toss, driven straight to cover
inswinger this time, Watson steers this for one
outswinger, starts middle, heads towards off, defended. Testing waters a bit

Asnodkar hits this powerfully past PK, but can't beat mid-off and gets just the single. And it's thanks to PK getting a hand to it that it doesn't go for four. I guess if you were feeling evil, you could put this down as a drop
frustration was conspicuous as Dravid looked to make room, Harris bowled the yorker/low full toss, and all Dravid managed was an inside edge onto the stumps
opens the face this time, but finds cover. Three good shots, three straight to fielders
another off-drive, but finds mid-off again. Will he go in the air now?
off-drive, but straight to mid-off
that's a gift on the pads, and Dravid plays the little pick-up shot - 8 off 3 now, is Dravid
pulls this off just back of a length, gets a single to deep backward
outswinger, just the touch of width Dravid needs, and he cuts it in front of square for four
defended to point
throws his bat at this, literally! Looks for the pull, almost falls on the stumps, loses the bat grip, somehow gets a single off the mis-hit
outswinger this time, Asnodkar moves across and pulls, and the leading edge just about clears mid-off
another inswinger, headed for top of off, pushed to cover. No room for Asnodkar, who loves to cut
sharp inswinger to start off with, almost an LBW but it is headed down the leg side
